text: Native compact coefficient-matrix storage implemented on the reserved paths, with full joint inverse-covariance weighting preserved. Full fit shared sources (35) plus pipeline support (12) rebuilt in isolated JVM/Scala.js harness: 235/235 tests passed on each platform in tests-7.log. The new public FixedEffects regressions agree with the independent mixed-TR R fixture for coefficients, SE, and full covariance; analytic correlated fields verify storage growth and compatibility/refusal behavior. Earlier six bounded-read test failures disappeared when all current fit sources replaced stale compiled fit dependencies. Harness alone exempts one existing unused pipeline ExecutionPlan import from fatal warnings; changed fit code remains warning-clean. Base dependency snapshot: 83 roots, 21114 files verified unchanged; graph dependencies separately captured (587 files). Native documentation added. Opt-in full-dimension covariance-field probe now running (four units, three runs, 206086 voxels, 17 coefficients); this does not admit whole-cohort memory or downstream integration. Issue remains doing pending final probe, exact consumer adoption, and real full-FIR combination gate.
